title: research-queue dispatcher landings: refresh must not cancel in-flight pytest-run; replay/refresh in a clean worktree; auto-resolve stamp-only conflicts
note: [2026-10-12 lane STAMP-RACE-2, dispatched by manager session_01G16FfyYSmDPQuuW55BuTmK; this row did not exist on main at dispatch, created by the lane] MEASURED 2026-10-12 (REST, last 48h = dispatch runs 188-223 from 2026-10-10T12:08Z): 14 of 35 completed runs red, ALL in job 'land' (0 in dispatch). By cause: (a) 5 refresh hit a CONTENT conflict (runs 191,193,200,217 on research/queue/*.yaml last_dispatched_at - two stamp PRs on one unit; 209 on the receipt json), refresh=failed_conflict, PR stayed dirty; (b) 3 'local changes would be overwritten by checkout' in ~1s (caller's dirty stamp yamls differ HEAD vs main; runs 195, 202, 215); (c) 1 refresh aborted by the same dirty-tree refusal with no conflict (run 204; run 215 also hit it before its checkout failure); (d) 5 timed out at 80m: 4 with refresh=refreshed (runs 196,197,203,213; PRs #17466 #17475 #17552 #17618) and 1 with not_needed_up_to_date (run 205, #17562, adopted into #17572 - cause beyond adoption NOT established). ROOT CAUSE: commit-to-main's one-shot stale-branch refresh fires at MINS/3=27m and merges main in; pytest-run has cancel-in-progress per PR, so the refresh KILLS the half-run suite and restarts ~45m. Across 62 automation/research-* PRs since 10-10 12:00Z every PR whose main moved shows a 27m 'queue' then a full second run; open-to-merge 64-79m vs an 80m wait; pytest-run itself 27-49m vs its 50m limit (#17654 and #17664 cancelled AT 50m after the restart). strict=false, so behind-main never blocks a merge; the refresh was only ever needed for red/absent checks. FIX (Tier-1, no timeout raised): action.yml (1) all post-commit work in a clean git worktree so a dirty caller tree can never break checkout/merge; (2) refresh only when PR CONFLICTS, or at 1/3 mark when head checks finished red/absent - never while in flight or green; (3) scripts/ops/resolve_stamp_conflicts.py resolves stamp-only conflicts to the later last_dispatched_at. Tests: tests/test_commit_to_main_stamp_race.py. NOT BUILT: pytest-run runs the full suite on data-only research PRs because ^research/ and ^comms/ are in its relevance filter (tests read them) - 27-49m each; shrinking that is a separate, riskier change. R12: action.yml is LANDING_MACHINERY so this PR cannot self-land - declared hold, needs a manager/human merge click (the dispatch asked for self-landing; R12 forbids it and was not defeated).

writeback.roadmap: M40: dispatcher landing reliability - refresh no longer cancels in-flight pytest-run; drop 'landing' tooling-gap wording from next once observed
writeback.arch: none: CI plumbing, no contract change

observation.what: two consecutive research-queue-dispatch cycles (event schedule or workflow_dispatch) whose 'land' job concludes success, with every stamp and result PR they open merged within 60 min of opening (measured: median 64-79 min before the fix, 27-49 min is pytest-run alone)
observation.how_to_check: gh api -X GET repos/benbaichmankass/Metis-Insights/actions/workflows/research-queue-dispatch.yml/runs -f per_page=20; for each run after the merge of this PR read the 'land' job conclusion; for each automation/research-* PR it opened compare created_at to merged_at (python3 scratchpad recipe: pulls?state=all, filter head.ref prefix automation/research). Also grep its 'Land' step logs for 'deferred_checks_in_flight' / 'not_needed_checks_green' and absence of a pytest-run cancelled by a 'Merge main so the required checks re-run' commit
